newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares lower in light trade, Autoliv gains.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares lower in light trade, Autoliv gains.

text.p: Swedish shares were lower at midday Monday in light trade with little buying interest while car safety equipment maker Autoliv gained ahead of the release of its six month results.
The Stockholm general index slipped 0.14 percent to 3,174.82 after shares worth 1.03 billion crowns changed hands.
Autoliv's six month results are due out around 1330 GMT. The market was expecting a pre-tax profit of $169 million and the share was six higher at 299 crowns.
Brokers said the only other spark of interest was in the engineering sector.
Industrial engineer Atlas Copco rose four crowns to 224 while speciality toolmaker and engineer Sandvik was two higher at 252 crowns.
The market's heavyweights were lower with telecoms group Ericsson dropping 1.5 to 362.5 crowns and drugs major Astra losing 1.5 to 145.5 crowns.
